description: This Java class 'RequiredDataAdvice' provides an Aspect-Oriented Programming (AOP) aspect that automatically sets and manages required metadata (such as creator, date changed, voided, retired, etc.) on OpenMRS domain objects during service method calls like save, void, unvoid, retire, and unretire. It intercepts these method calls, determines the type of operation, and applies the appropriate handlers recursively, including handling nested collections and related objects.

classes.name: RequiredDataAdvice
classes.description: AOP advice class that intercepts service layer methods related to saving, voiding, unvoiding, retiring, and unretiring OpenMRS objects to automatically set required data such as creator, date voided, date retired, etc.

methods.name: before
methods.description: Main advice method that determines the type of service method invoked (save, create, void, unvoid, retire, unretire) and applies the corresponding handlers recursively to the main object and its nested collections.

methods.name: methodNameEndsWithClassName
methods.description: Utility to verify if the method name ends with the simple name of the class of the primary argument, including its superclasses.

methods.name: recursivelyHandle
methods.description: Overloaded static methods that invoke handlers for an OpenMRS object, setting metadata recursively on the object and related objects, using the current user and date by default.

methods.name: getChildCollection
methods.description: Uses reflection to access a collection attribute from an OpenMRS object, via getter method or direct access if annotated, handling accessibility issues.

methods.name: isOpenmrsObjectCollection
methods.description: Checks whether the given object is a non-empty collection of OpenmrsObject instances.

methods.name: isHandlerMarkedAsDisabled
methods.description: Determines if a particular handler type is disabled for a specific field based on annotations.
